svg.text: Print open side up, 0.2 mm layers; 30 long x 40 wide x 10 high, corners R3.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Inside: 27 x 28.6, floor 1. Strap notch at each strap end (30 mm face): 22 wide,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4.5 deep, 6 high from the underside; it bridges, no support needed.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Spring bar holes: print, then drill 1.0 mm right through each horn

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (the solid corner beside the notch), 2 from the end, 3 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Screw holes: one per horn, 13 each side of centre along the 30 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: length and 2.6 in from the end; open to 1.6 mm, 4.5 deep.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cell pocket: ribs 1.5 high leave 20.35 x 26.62, 0.3 mm round the cell.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Charging opening 4 x 8 through the floor, 0.4 from the end wall,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in a collar 0.8 thick and 2 high that holds the glue.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a 1.0 mm drill passes each bar hole; the cell drops into its

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pocket by its own weight; nothing is left in the notch.
